About Viz.ai

Viz.ai is the leader in building and deploying AI-powered Care Pathways and helping doctors do their work. The Viz Platform is deployed in 2,000 hospitals across the United States and trusted by many of the leading life sciences companies. The platform uniquely combines real-time, multimodal clinical data with deep clinician engagement to detect disease earlier, coordinate care teams, and help ensure patients receive the right treatment faster. Viz.ai was the first company to be awarded CMS reimbursement for AI and is ranked the #1 Healthcare AI Platform by hospitals and health systems in the Black Book Research survey. For more information, visit Viz.ai.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on product leader who has repeatedly brought EHR-integrated products into production, built trusted clinical data capabilities, and helped health systems buy and adopt enterprise software. You use AI to move from customer insight to working product exceptionally quickly.

Your mission is to make Viz easier to buy, faster to integrate, and more valuable across the health system, with trusted data that makes that value measurable. You will lead the product strategy and commercialization of EHR integrations and shared data capabilities that power clinical workflows, provider analytics, life sciences reporting, and research.

You can move between an executive buying conversation, an integration discussion with hospital IT, and a working prototype with users. You understand both how to bring clinical data into a product and how to make it reliable enough for the decisions and analyses it supports.

You will work closely with Suite Product Owners, Platform Product and Engineering, Clinical, Life Sciences, Sales, and Implementation. You own customer insight, data strategy and definitions, integration and data priorities, product requirements for data quality and metrics, commercial readiness, and evidence of adoption and value. Platform Product and Engineering own technical solutioning and production delivery; you remain accountable for customer outcomes after launch.

The role reports to the Chief Product Officer, currently the CEO. US-based, with regular customer-facing travel.

What you will do

Accelerate and deepen EHR integrations

Identify and remove the product, technical, and organizational barriers that slow deployment or limit clinical workflows. Understand data availability, integration requirements, hospital resources, and approvals across EHR environments before committing to a delivery path. Advance integrations into richer clinical context, embedded experiences, supported write-back, and actionable workflows. Turn recurring blockers into reusable capabilities, validation tools, and deployment playbooks, making each successive implementation faster and less resource-intensive.

Build a trusted clinical data foundation

Own the product strategy for a shared, reliable source of truth for clinical and workflow data across Viz products. Define the data sources, clinical variables, common definitions, and reusable capabilities needed by our products and customers. Bring together EHR data, Viz activity data, and relevant operational or financial data according to the use case.

Partner with Engineering and clinical experts to set requirements for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and traceability. Ensure AI-extracted clinical variables have appropriate validation and ongoing quality checks, using automation where it improves speed and reliability. Enable downstream teams to build applications, dashboards, sponsor reports, and research workflows on the same trusted foundation.

Make value demonstration part of the product

Work with customers and our Clinical, Life Sciences, and commercial teams to define success before development begins. Translate clinical, operational, and financial outcomes into measurement requirements and identify the data needed to support them, including customer data beyond the EHR. Ensure prioritized capabilities launch with the instrumentation, consistent metric definitions, and data quality needed to demonstrate adoption and value. Make data limitations and gaps visible so teams can judge what conclusions the evidence supports.

Build products around enterprise buying needs

Work directly with CIOs, CMIOs, CFOs, and other health-system decision-makers to understand priorities, budgets, buying criteria, and objections. Translate those insights into product choices and demonstrable value. Address the needs of economic buyers, clinical users, and technical stakeholders. Prioritize the integration, data, usability, or reliability gaps that most affect adoption and purchasing decisions.

Help win and expand enterprise business

Partner with Sales on discovery, executive alignment, demonstrations, business cases, evaluation design, objection handling, and expansion. Own product positioning, the integration and data value proposition, and reusable commercial assets. Ensure customer commitments have a credible delivery path and a clear plan for demonstrating value, with prerequisites and dependencies understood early.

Build and validate directly using AI

Use AI coding, design, and analytical tools to create working prototypes, demonstrations, and experiments yourself. Test with customers early and validate the workflow and value proposition before committing production engineering effort. Use AI to accelerate data exploration and quality checks while evaluating the reliability of its outputs. Know when a prototype answers the question and when production engineering, security review, or clinical validation is required.

Turn customer learning into reusable platform value

Partner with Suite Product Owners to identify shared needs and prioritize capabilities that unlock multiple products or customers. Validate proposed platform investments across suites and make explicit choices between reuse and account-specific customization. Sequence work with Platform Product and Engineering, then use production adoption, customer feedback, and measured value to guide subsequent improvements.

What you bring

  • Repeated production EHR-integration experience. You have personally led the product side of multiple successful deployments across independent health systems, including Epic and Oracle Health/Cerner environments. You can explain what you owned, what blocked progress, and how you reduced time or effort while enabling deeper integration.

  • Clinical data and informatics expertise. You have worked directly with production EHR data and built clinical data, analytics, or evidence capabilities used by customers. You understand variation across institutions, clinical terminology and context, missing or inconsistent data, and the validation needed for a specific use. You can explain how you established data integrity, including quality checks for AI-extracted variables where applicable.

  • Strong technical and workflow fluency. You can work credibly with hospital IT and engineering on SMART on FHIR, HL7 v2/FHIR, authentication, permissions, patient and encounter context, and supported bidirectional workflows. You understand the approvals, security requirements, resource constraints, and operational dependencies that determine whether an integration reaches production.

  • A track record of building and helping sell enterprise healthcare products. You have translated executive needs into shipped products and directly contributed to winning or expanding business. You can discuss specific buyers, budget decisions, product trade-offs, and commercial outcomes, including how customer value was measured.

  • Demonstrated AI-native building capability. You use tools such as Claude Code, Claude Design, or equivalents in your daily work. You can show substantive prototypes, applications, automations, or analytical tools you personally built, and explain how you evaluated their quality and used them to accelerate customer learning.

  • Evidence of operating at high speed. You have delivered useful products with small teams, incomplete information, and changing priorities. You are comfortable prototyping in days and shipping incremental improvements frequently while maintaining appropriate production, data quality, security, and clinical safeguards.

  • Senior product judgment and cross-functional leadership. Typically seven or more years in healthcare technology product leadership, or equivalent founder experience, with direct accountability for product decisions and customer outcomes. You work effectively across commercial, clinical, and technical teams, including geographically distributed teams, without relying on extensive process or management layers.

How we work

We expect product leaders to be builders. You will spend substantial time with customers, work directly in AI tools, and bring working examples into discussions. We minimize unnecessary handoffs and judge progress through shipped capabilities, customer learning, adoption, and commercial results. We design measurement and data quality into the work from the outset and use automation to reduce avoidable effort and delays.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

  • Faster and deeper integrations. Measurable reductions in time to production, implementation effort, and bespoke work across independent health systems, with richer clinical context, embedded experiences, and supported workflow execution in active use.

  • Trusted and reusable data. Priority clinical variables and metrics have clear definitions, traceable sources, and repeatable quality checks. Provider analytics, life sciences reporting, and research use a shared foundation, with less manual reconciliation and duplication.

  • Value demonstration built into delivery. Priority launches include agreed success measures and the data needed to assess them. Teams can produce credible, repeatable evidence of adoption and customer value with clear visibility into data limitations.

  • Commercial impact. Integration and data capabilities remove barriers to enterprise sales and expansion, accelerate customer time to value, and make subsequent deployments and suite expansion easier.

Why should you join us?

  • If you are looking to make an impact, we are mission-driven and are making a difference in peoples’ lives every day.

  • If you want to be a part of an amazing team , our people are the heart of everything we do.

  • If you are a self-starter and naturally motivated, our work is driven by curiosity, innovation and team collaboration which allows us to leverage our skills immeasurably.

We are a remote-first company across the U.S. and EU, with a team in Tel Aviv operating in a flexible hybrid model, conveniently located near a train line.

Viz.ai is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided.

In the U.S., Viz offers competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), generous vacation, and additional benefits to full-time employees. Viz.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, or local law.

Employees in Israel are offered a comprehensive benefits package, including, among others: dental insurance, performance-based bonuses, a Cibus meal allowance, meals at the office, and more.

If you’re applying for a position in San Francisco, please review the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance guidelines applicable in your area.
